description.value: Soapolallie Soapworks is a small-batch artisan soap and personal care maker in downtown Enderby, BC, named after the soapberry plant significant to Indigenous cultures of the region. The business emphasizes eco-friendly, natural ingredients and deep community ties, partnering with the Kingfisher Interpretive Centre on environmental stewardship and salmon habitat initiatives. Located just off Hwy 97A with free parking, it has offered cyclists a unique locally made gift stop in the Okanagan-Shuswap corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real and located at 611 Cliff Avenue, Enderby, BC V0E 1V0 with phone 250-517-0527. However, the website prominently states 'Soapolallie is transitioning to an online-only experience as we close our storefront' with the online shop paused until July 3rd, 2026 — as of today (June 28, 2026) the physical storefront appears to be in the final stages of closing or already closed. No amenity evidence (bike parking, washrooms, water) is present anywhere in the website content, and OSM tags are entirely empty for this record.
concerns: Storefront closing: website explicitly states transition to online-only as physical store closes. Physical accessibility after July 3, 2026 unknown.
OSM record has no tags at all (empty osm_tags) — likely a manually added candidate rather than a mapped OSM node.
OSM lat/lon (50.5506, -119.1391) places the pin slightly outside downtown Enderby; website address 611 Cliff Avenue should be verified against mapping tools.
Website shows two slightly different store hour descriptions across pages (Tues–Sat on /visit-us vs Thurs–Sat on front page), suggesting content may be outdated or inconsistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The physical storefront is confirmed closing — the website states the business is 'transitioning to an online-only experience as we close our storefront' with the online shop paused until July 3, 2026. It is unclear whether the Enderby retail location will remain physically accessible to the public after that date; manual verification of storefront status recommended before listing.
